covers: Wall Street's first half-hour on 20 Nov 2026 (quotes to 16:57 SAST), the JSE late session, and Intuit's first-quarter results filed on 19 Nov
headline: Intuit -4.2% after cutting its revenue outlook; Nasdaq -0.4% at the open, JSE All Share -1.6% late in the session
summary: The JSE All Share was at 104,501.42 and the Top 40 at 96,672.27 at about 16:57 SAST on 20 Nov 2026, 1.6% and 1.7% below Thursday's closes and about 7% lower than on 13 Nov (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance). On Wall Street the S&P 500 was at 7,186.05 (+0.1%) and the Nasdaq at 23,787.04 (-0.4%) half an hour after the open, about 5% lower on the week; Intuit fell 4.2% to $297.13 after trimming its full-year revenue outlook. The rand was at R17.42 per dollar, 3.9% weaker than on 13 Nov, and gold at $3,573.90 was 1.4% up on the day but 8.0% down on the week.

items.title: Intuit falls 4.2% to $297.13 after cutting its full-year revenue outlook
items.summary: First-quarter (to 31 Oct) revenue rose 12% to $4.35bn, ahead of the $4.31bn estimate, and adjusted EPS was $2.91. But full-year revenue guidance was cut to $23.08–23.37bn from $23.28–23.51bn (consensus $23.40bn) because of weaker Credit Karma, and second-quarter revenue guidance of $4.93–4.95bn is below the $5.11bn consensus; profit guidance was kept. Intuit also agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for about $3.68bn (Intuit 8-K and press release, 19 Nov 2026; price from LRC Stock Scanner, 20 Nov 2026 16:57 SAST). The LRC Watchlist (14 Nov) lists Intuit as BUY with a $426 fair value; the share is further below that level, and the rating is unchanged.

items.title: S&P 500 7,186.05 (+0.1%), Nasdaq 23,787.04 (-0.4%) after the open
items.summary: Against Thursday's closes of 7,175.83 and 23,879.20, at 16:57 SAST. Both remain about 5% below their 13 Nov levels (S&P 500 7,561.67, Nasdaq 25,136.27). The US 10-year Treasury yield was at 4.97%, down from 5.05% at Thursday's close (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance, 20 Nov 2026).

items.title: All Share 104,501.42 (-1.6%), Top 40 96,672.27 (-1.7%) heading into the close

items.title: Miners and Naspers lead the falls: Anglo American -4.5%, Naspers -4.3%, Sibanye-Stillwater -4.0%, Prosus -3.8%
